title: Lists and ScrollViews
description: Understand how to display lists and implement scrolling behavior in React Native apps.

quiz.question: Which React Native component is best suited for rendering a large list of data efficiently?
quiz.explanation: FlatList efficiently renders large lists by only rendering items currently visible on the screen.

quiz.question: What is the main difference between ScrollView and FlatList?
options: ScrollView renders all content at once; FlatList renders items lazily
ScrollView is only for horizontal scrolling; FlatList is vertical
ScrollView can only contain text; FlatList can contain any component
quiz.correctAnswer: ScrollView renders all content at once; FlatList renders items lazily
quiz.explanation: ScrollView renders all its children at once which can affect performance for large lists, while FlatList renders items on demand.

quiz.question: Which prop is required for FlatList to uniquely identify each item?
quiz.explanation: The keyExtractor prop tells FlatList how to extract a unique key for each item.

quiz.question: What is the default orientation of ScrollView?
How can you make a ScrollView scroll horizontally?
options: Set the horizontal prop to true
quiz.correctAnswer: Set the horizontal prop to true
quiz.explanation: Setting the horizontal prop makes ScrollView scroll horizontally.

quiz.question: Which prop can you use to improve FlatList performance by providing fixed item heights?
quiz.explanation: getItemLayout lets FlatList skip measurement by providing fixed heights for items.

quiz.question: What prop can be used to render a header component at the top of a FlatList?
quiz.explanation: ListHeaderComponent renders a header above the FlatList items.

quiz.question: True or False: ScrollView is suitable for lists with thousands of items.
quiz.explanation: ScrollView renders all items at once, which is inefficient for very large lists.

quiz.question: Which method is triggered when the user scrolls to the end of a FlatList?
quiz.explanation: onEndReached is called when the list scroll position is near the end, useful for lazy loading.

quiz.question: What is the purpose of the refreshing prop in FlatList?
options: To indicate whether the list is currently refreshing
quiz.correctAnswer: To indicate whether the list is currently refreshing
quiz.explanation: refreshing is a boolean to show a loading indicator during pull-to-refresh.
